title: Our Services
description: Cybersecurity, AI, application services, cloud and managed services. Our teams take charge of your IT environments, from assessment through to daily operations.

sections.title: Our Services
sections.lead: Our teams take charge of your IT environments, from assessment through to daily operations, and move them forward on the priorities you set.

sections.intro: Complementary services, deployed together or on their own, around what your teams already cover.

items.title: Cybersecurity
items.text: Protect your digital assets and prove regulatory compliance: SEvOC (SOC), penetration testing, OT and IoT security, identity and access management.

items.title: AI and Automation
items.text: Put AI to work in your business processes with clear governance in place: opportunity assessment, custom agents, Copilot for Microsoft 365.

items.title: Cloud
items.text: Modernize your infrastructure at your own pace: migration, multicloud, hybrid environments, backup and disaster recovery.

items.title: Application Services
items.text: Build, modernize and maintain your business applications: Ø Studio (Power Platform and Dynamics 365 development), Microsoft 365, ServiceNow.

items.title: Managed Services
items.text: Simplify day-to-day IT management: IT governance, outsourcing, technical support, infrastructure, network and systems management.

sections.title: What Stands Behind Every Service
paragraphs: Our services are backed by recognized certifications, top-tier technology partnerships and teams who know what your industry demands. All of it is documented.

sections.title: Let’s Talk About Your Needs
sections.body: Tell us what you already have in place. We'll propose the scope that fits.
